# Exponentials and logarithms

Powers of e and two, and logarithms in base e, two and ten.

<h2 id="exp"><code>Exp</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Exp(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Exp(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes `e` raised to `x`.
The error is at most one ulp. Positive infinity returns positive infinity, negative infinity returns `+0.0`, and a
NaN remains a NaN. Finite results overflow to infinity or underflow to zero when required by `float64`.

| Overload                              | Summary                                            |
| ------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Exp(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes `e` raised to `x`.                        |
| `pub func Exp(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes `e` raised to `x` at `float32` precision. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Exp.rux#L33)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description |
| ---- | --------------------- | ----------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | exponent    |

**Returns**: `e` raised to `x`

<h2 id="exp2"><code>Exp2</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Exp2(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Exp2(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes two raised to `x`.
The error is at most one ulp, and an in-range integer exponent is exact. Positive infinity returns positive
infinity, negative infinity returns zero, and a NaN remains a NaN.

| Overload                               | Summary                                            |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Exp2(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes two raised to `x`.                        |
| `pub func Exp2(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes two raised to `x` at `float32` precision. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Exp2.rux#L12)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description     |
| ---- | --------------------- | --------------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | binary exponent |

**Returns**: two raised to `x`

<h2 id="expm1"><code>Expm1</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Expm1(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Expm1(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes `Exp(x) - 1` without losing precision near zero.
The error is at most one ulp and remains small relative to the result as `x` approaches zero. A signed zero returns
itself, positive infinity returns positive infinity, negative infinity returns `-1.0`, and a NaN remains a NaN.

| Overload                                | Summary                                                                          |
| --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Expm1(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes `Exp(x) - 1` without losing precision near zero.                        |
| `pub func Expm1(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes `Exp(x) - 1` at `float32` precision without losing precision near zero. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Expm1.rux#L13)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description |
| ---- | --------------------- | ----------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | exponent    |

**Returns**: `e` raised to `x`, minus one

<h2 id="log"><code>Log</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Log(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Log(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes the natural logarithm of `x`.
The error is at most one ulp. Either signed zero returns negative infinity, a negative value returns a NaN, positive
infinity returns itself, and a NaN remains a NaN.

| Overload                              | Summary                                                       |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Log(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes the natural logarithm of `x`.                        |
| `pub func Log(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the natural logarithm of `x` at `float32` precision. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Log.rux#L69)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description                                |
| ---- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | positive value whose logarithm is computed |

**Returns**: the base-`e` logarithm of `x`

<h2 id="log10"><code>Log10</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Log10(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Log10(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes the base-ten logarithm of `x`.
The error is at most one ulp, and an exact power of ten returns its exact exponent. Either signed zero returns
negative infinity, a negative value returns a NaN, positive infinity returns itself, and a NaN remains a NaN.

| Overload                                | Summary                                                        |
| --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Log10(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes the base-ten logarithm of `x`.                        |
| `pub func Log10(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the base-ten logarithm of `x` at `float32` precision. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Log10.rux#L14)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description                                |
| ---- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | positive value whose logarithm is computed |

**Returns**: the base-ten logarithm of `x`

<h2 id="log1p"><code>Log1p</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Log1p(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Log1p(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes `Log(1 + x)` without losing precision near zero.
`Log1p(0.0)` is zero with the argument's sign, `Log1p(-1.0)` is negative infinity, and an argument below -1 has no
real logarithm and gives a NaN.

| Overload                                | Summary                                                                          |
| --------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Log1p(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes `Log(1 + x)` without losing precision near zero.                        |
| `pub func Log1p(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes `Log(1 + x)` at `float32` precision without losing precision near zero. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Log1p.rux#L26)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description                                    |
| ---- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | value added to one before taking the logarithm |

**Returns**: the natural logarithm of `1 + x`

<h2 id="log2"><code>Log2</code></h2>

```rux
pub func Log2(x: float64) -> float64
pub func Log2(x: float32) -> float32
```

Computes the base-two logarithm of `x`.
The error is at most one ulp, and an exact power of two returns its exact exponent. Either signed zero returns
negative infinity, a negative value returns a NaN, positive infinity returns itself, and a NaN remains a NaN.

| Overload                               | Summary                                                        |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pub func Log2(x: float64) -> float64` | Computes the base-two logarithm of `x`.                        |
| `pub func Log2(x: float32) -> float32` | Computes the base-two logarithm of `x` at `float32` precision. |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Math/Src/Log2.rux#L14)

**Parameters**

| Name | Type                  | Description                                |
| ---- | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `x`  | `float64` / `float32` | positive value whose logarithm is computed |

**Returns**: the base-two logarithm of `x`
